name: Rusty Cleaver
prompt: A heavy, pitted butcher's cleaver scavenged from a frontier town — broad rust-mottled blade with a chipped edge, sweat-darkened wrapped-cord handle, a single bright nick where it's been honed. Crude, brutal, dependable.
cardartAction: swung in a heavy downward arc, rust flaking off the edge, a gritty impact spark at the blade tip

name: Coffin Lid
prompt: A splintered wooden coffin lid hefted as an improvised shield-weapon — long hexagonal plank, iron nail-heads, a faded painted cross worn to a ghost, one cracked corner. Heavy, defensive, grim.
cardartAction: slammed forward edge-on as a guard, splinters and dust bursting off the impact face

name: Branding Iron
prompt: A long black wrought-iron branding rod, the business end a glowing molten-orange sigil, heat-haze shimmering off the metal, the haft wrapped in scorched leather. Cross-class INT melee — magic by way of red-hot iron.
cardartAction: thrust forward, the white-hot sigil flaring and leaving a searing after-glow trail in the air
